correctness.rationale: For all integer 2<=p<q, the vertex law includes all partial permutation matrices, including empty matching; the exact cell probabilities are a=F_(p-1,q-1)/F_(p,q), b=F_(p-2,q-2)/F_(p,q) for disjoint row/column cells, and zero for mutually conflicting cells. Its covariance operator is a I+b(J_p-I_p)⊗(J_q-I_q)-a² J_p⊗J_q. Tensoring constant and contrast subspaces yields four dimensions and eigenvalues λ0=a+(p-1)(q-1)b-pqa², λR=a-(q-1)b, λC=a-(p-1)b, λI=a+b. Strict positive first gap follows from p simple positive zeros of L_p^(q-p), which factor the matching size PGF into distinct Bernoulli factors; λR−λ0=Σ(π_i−πbar)²/[q(p−1)]>0. Other gaps (q-p)b and pb are explicit, λ0>0 by varied matching size. Fixed p, q→∞ matching-size deficit gives λ0=q^-2+O_p(q^-3), λI=q^-1+O_p(q^-2), condition ratio q+O_p(1). Independently counted small boards and exact rational eigenvalues; finite checks are not the universal Laguerre proof.
